observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with a glowing multicolored background and a white floor
observation.dancers: group of seven women, mixed ethnicities
observation.formation_and_space: horizontal line formation, facing forward with slight individual variations
observation.posture: upright torso with soft knees, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: fast, rhythmic stepping and shifting of weight on the beat, low to the ground
observation.arms_and_hands: arms moving fluidly in coordination with hip movements, sometimes bent at the elbow with hands near the head or hips
observation.hips_and_torso: frequent hip rotations and shaking (undulations and hip circles) characteristic of soukous
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level maintained with bent knees, occasional pivots and turns
observation.costume_and_props: matching short outfits (crop tops, shorts, skirts) with caps and sneakers in the first half, changing to red/plaid outfits and boots in the second half
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and subtle weight transfers are obscured by rapid editing, camera cuts, and low resolution.

signature_moments.what: synchronized hip rolls while stepping side to side in a line
raising arms overhead while stepping and accentuating hip sways
fast hip shaking with arms held close to the body
pivoting with circular hip movements and arm extensions
facing backward and emphasizing deep hip drops and shakes
